vendabilityGrid.weightsDescription: The score is the weighted average of the criteria that can be assessed. A criterion without data (no reviews, too few views) does not penalise the product. A weight of 0 removes the criterion. These values are provisional until the final grid is set.
vendabilityGrid.totalWeight: Total weight: {total}. Each criterion counts for its share of this total.
vendabilityGrid.targetsDescription: A product that reaches the target scores 100 points on the criterion.
